lines.1: 「Tomorrow we have a major sports-festival meeting, so the executive committee won't be meeting.」
lines.3: 「But that means next week will be busier, so yoroshiku.」
lines.6: 「Hah. You're always saying you'll crush people. You're no better.」
lines.8: 「Try it! What are you even gonna crush, huh!? You can't crush anything, all-talk girl!」
lines.9: 「Heh. I'll make you cry and crush your dignity.」
lines.11: 「Leave them. More importantly, Princess, isn't it pretty late to be holding a big sports-festival meeting now?」
lines.12: 「The head of the athletics committee got sick and is recuperating at home.」
lines.14: 「So everyone has to cover a bunch of things. There'll be another meeting Thursday too. Such a pain.」
lines.17: 「Maybe I'll have you massage my shoulders.」
lines.19: 「Come on, Ellie. I'll massage them for you, so don't tease Tsushima.」
lines.20: This had started as a proper time for confirming announcements.
lines.21: Before we knew it, the executive committee was back to its usual self.
